backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260512-032 policy semantics.
decision_rationale: The official Space `liquidity_tier=ok` anchor risk scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must remain shared production-visible metadata/helper wiring only; live Space slots remain zero.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe; any accepted change must remain default-off metadata until forward evidence matures.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: scale official Space signals whose registry liquidity_tier is ok.

2_history_check.exp-20260512-014/015/016/019/021: Rejected peer-trend, 52w, breadth, R/R, and volume refinements; those variables stay fixed.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-023: Rejected GSAT candidate-pool expansion; no ticker expansion in this test.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-032: Accepted launch/lunar 1.10x theme scalar; this is the fixed before state.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-035: Rejected data/defense theme scalar; this test uses a different registry field, not another data/defense scalar.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_liquidity_tier_ok_risk_scalar. Candidate pool, accepted Space risk scalars, targets, stops, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 total trades, and nonzero adjusted liquidity-tier signals.
gate_questions.5_reproducibility: This script reruns core, accepted exp-20260512-032 Space stack, and each liquidity-tier scalar across the canonical augmented Space snapshots.

hypothesis: The next Space alpha should be catalyst-quality risk allocation, not LLM soft-ranking, ticker expansion, or another data/defense theme retune. A production-visible liquidity anchor may identify official Space signals that can carry more default-off risk without increasing live slots.
interpretation: The official Space `liquidity_tier=ok` anchor risk scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must remain shared production-visible metadata/helper wiring only; live Space slots remain zero.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data remains below the closed-decision gate; this run uses deterministic production registry metadata.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry adjacent liquidity-tier Space scalars on the same frozen snapshots. Future Space work should use forward event replacement value or a genuinely new catalyst-quality field.
single_causal_variable: risk scalar for official Space signals keyed only to production universe-registry liquidity_tier == ok
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking is data-limited; GSAT and mature satcom candidate expansions are rejected; recent Space TQS, IWM, peer, 52w, breadth, R/R, volume, and data/defense variants are either accepted context or anti-repeat.
